_comment: Registry of Domo instances ArmOS talks to, keyed by instance name. Copy to .claude/instances.json in your PROJECT root. Convention: 'domo-mcp' is the primary / active-customer server (repoint it, or swap its token, per customer via /server). Every ADDITIONAL customer gets its own server named 'domo-<instance>' in .mcp.json using the same layout: an X-DOMO-DEVELOPER-TOKEN header set to ${DOMO_<INSTANCE_UPPER_SNAKE>_DEVELOPER_TOKEN}. Token values live in .env (git-ignored), referenced here by env var name only. Use /server to list instances or add a new one.

starkenergyservices.note: Anonymous toolkit — connects without a developer token, so it has no header in .mcp.json.
